0xFE00 before a block's DC: psx-spx's MDEC skips it (mdec.c follows), PCSX-Redux decodes it as a block (DC -512, then the end), so every later block shifts
out-of-range values: mdec.c saturates the coefficients to 11 bits and clamps each colour to 0..255 (psx-spx); PCSX-Redux's colours wrap or come out at the other end of the range
